statement: Let k be an uncountable algebraically closed field of characteristic p > 3. There do not exist a smooth projective threefold V , a very ample Cartier divisor HV , and a nonzero effective Cartier divisor D = P α mαDα satisfying all the following conditions: (i) The Dα are distinct prime divisors, mα ∈ Z>0, the support of D is connected and has simple normal crossings, and gcdα mα = 1. (ii) D is nef, its restriction to every Dα is numerically trivial, and DH2 V > 0, D2 HV = 0, n(D) = 3. (iii) The line bundle OD(D) on the possibly nonreduced Cartier scheme D is torsion. (iv) For some integer b ≥ 0 and integers bα, there is an isomorphism on a neighborhood of Supp D, ω⊗pb V ≃ OV X α bαDα  . (1)
